name: Café Counter
description: The café counter at the back of the shop: a temperamental espresso machine, a glass case with a few pastries, a chalkboard menu half-erased, and the shop ledger open beside the till. Two small tables sit within arm's reach of the warmth of the machine. This is Iris's home turf.
example_text: Café counter: espresso machine, pastry case, chalkboard menu, the till and shop ledger, two small tables.

properties.lighting: warm, close, the amber glow of a counter lamp
